title: Java Software Engineer - Connectors - Remote
description:
Jitterbit automates and orchestrates business systems to empower teams, unlock value, and accelerate business transformation. With Jitterbit, organizations can streamline operations, enhance data accessibility, and deliver on a growing list of IT needs more quickly and confidently.

For organizations ready to modernize and innovate, Jitterbit provides a unified AI-infused low-code platform for integration, orchestration, automation, and app development that accelerates business transformation, boosts productivity, and unlocks value. The Jitterbit Harmony platform, including iPaaS, API Manager, App Builder and EDI, future-proofs operations, simplifies complexity and drives innovation for organizations globally.

**Job Description**

Jitterbit is seeking a Java Backend Software Engineer to join our Engineer team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) and API Management platform that has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and API Manager platform to solve mission-critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers’ systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?

About the Team

The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations.

Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists.

Key team values:

* Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
* Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
* Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
* Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay ahead

About the Job

As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

* Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365.
* Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc.) for multi-tenant SaaS environments.
* Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven).
* Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles.
* Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems.
* Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability.
* Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization.
* Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization.

About You

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built.

You will be successful in this role if you:

* Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer.
* Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture.
* Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives.
* Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers.
* Are able to make data-driven decisions.
* Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from.
* Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push.

**Qualifications**

We are looking for:

* 7+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements.
* 5+ years working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants.
* Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems.
* Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter-service communication patterns.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns.
* Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e).

Technical Skills and Experience:

* Expert-level Java (Java 8+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc.).
* Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling).
* Message brokers & event streaming: Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, or similar; understanding of at-least-once delivery, dead-letter queues, and stream processing.
* Database technologies: Strong SQL (query optimization, indexing); experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra) and their consistency trade-offs.
* Containerization & orchestration: Proficiency with Docker; practical experience with Kubernetes or container runtimes in production.
* Version control: Advanced Git workflows (branching strategies, rebasing, cherry-picking); experience with GitHub or similar platforms.
* CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar; ability to write build pipelines, deployment scripts, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* OS & systems: Comfortable with Linux command line; understanding of OS-level concepts (memory allocation, processes, file systems, networking).
* Observability: Experience with logging (ELK, Splunk), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin).

**Additional Information**

**What You’ll Get:**

* Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
* Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes.
* Career development and mentorship
* A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heart

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Cost & Engineering Efficiency
  
  
Location: Noida/ Bangalore (Hybrid)
  
  
**Summary Of Role**
Sumo Logic's microservices architecture, hosted on AWS, ingests petabytes of data daily across many geographic regions in support of our planet-scale observability and security products, serving hundreds of millions of queries a day against thousands of petabytes of data. At that scale, every inefficiency — in code, architecture, or infrastructure — compounds into real cost.
  
  
This role sits within the Product SRE organization, working alongside your global SRE team on your product area's reliability roadmap — with a mandate that leads with code as much as operations. You'll find where Sumo's systems are spending more compute, storage, or engineering time than necessary, and fix it in the code and architecture, not just the infra config, while also carrying the fuller SRE mandate — reliability, security posture, and improving the day-to-day experience of the engineers within your product area. You'll be part of a team that blends SRE and backend software engineering skillsets, partnering closely with product engineering teams across your product area.
  
  
This is an engineering role — the work is about shipping code, architecture, and system-level changes that improve unit economics, not managing cost dashboards, tagging, or reserved-instance/savings-plan purchasing.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Continuously discover cost and efficiency opportunities through production profiling, telemetry, cost data, capacity trends, and system-level analysis — across algorithmic inefficiencies, resource-heavy code paths, and architectural decisions — and turn ambiguous problems into prioritized engineering initiatives.
* Apply performance and capacity engineering techniques to understand CPU, memory, storage, network, and I/O behavior under real production workloads, and optimize the resulting resource footprint.
* Write production-grade code to implement the optimizations you identify — JVM/GC tuning, algorithmic and resource-efficiency improvements, re-architecting inefficient services — in systems that process petabytes of data daily.
* Define and track engineering efficiency metrics such as cost per GB ingested, cost per query, cost per event, resource utilization, or cost per customer workload, and translate the work into measurable impact for engineering and business stakeholders.
* Lead complex, cross-team engineering initiatives from problem discovery through design, implementation, rollout, and measurement — influencing teams where you don't have direct ownership — and help establish engineering patterns and practices that make cost and efficiency a continuous part of the development lifecycle.
* Partner with engineering teams in your product area to prioritize changes, and with developer infrastructure and Global SRE to align with the broader reliability roadmap.
* Participate in the SRE responsibilities for different product areas — SLOs, on-call, incident response, and blameless RCA — using those experiences to identify systemic reliability, performance, and efficiency improvements.

**What You’ll Have**

* B.Tech, M.Tech, or equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of industry experience with a demonstrated track record of ownership.
* Strong CS fundamentals — comfortable with algorithmic complexity, data-structure performance characteristics, and system design at scale.
* Ability to author production-ready code in at least one OO/systems language (Java, Scala, Go, C++, or similar) — depth of engineering ability matters more than which language.
* Experience with distributed systems and microservice architectures in production.
* Demonstrated track record of independently identifying ambiguous performance, scalability, or cost problems and driving engineering changes that produced measurable improvements in production.
* Strong ability to reason quantitatively about system behavior, capacity, performance, and cost, and use production data to validate hypotheses and measure outcomes.
* Working fluency with cloud infrastructure (AWS compute, storage, networking) — enough to reason about cost and architectural tradeoffs.
* Comfort moving across the stack, from application code to the infrastructure it runs on, to find root causes of inefficiency.

**Nice to have**

* JVM tuning and GC optimization experience at scale.
* Exposure to cost-attribution/FinOps practices or tooling.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, or modern CI/CD tooling.
* Prior SRE experience — on-call, SLOs, incident response.
* Experience with streaming technologies (Kafka, Kafka Streams) or observability/security platforms.

**Why this role**

* Visibility — Cost/efficiency work maps directly to metrics the business already tracks.
* Scope you define — you identify where the opportunities are rather than executing a fixed backlog.
* Real scale — systems ingesting petabytes of data daily and serving hundreds of millions of queries.

**About Us**
Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.
  
  
Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

Clipchamp**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with strong hands-on expertise in Salesforce development, customization, integrations, and enterprise solution delivery. **Key Responsibilities**

1. Salesforce Development and Customization

* Design, develop, customize, and maintain Salesforce applications based on business requirements.

* Build responsive and reusable user interfaces using Lightning Web Components (LWC).
* Write optimized SOQL queries and work with Salesforce data models, objects, security, and automation.

2. Salesforce Administration and Configuration

* Configure and maintain profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules, and Flows.
* Maintain Salesforce security, access controls, automation, and platform configurations.
* Ensure solutions follow Salesforce platform capabilities, security standards, and development best practices.

3. Integrations and Enterprise Solutions

* Develop and maintain integrations with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs and other integration mechanisms.
* Support the design and implementation of scalable Salesforce solutions for enterprise requirements.
* Collaborate with business analysts, architects, QA engineers, and other developers to deliver effective solutions.

4. Testing, Deployment, and Support

* Perform unit testing, debugging, code reviews, and performance optimization.
* Troubleshoot production issues and provide ongoing technical support and maintenance.
* Follow Salesforce development standards, security practices, and deployment procedures.
* Participate in solution testing, deployment, and post-deployment support.

**Required Technical Skills & Competencies**

* Strong hands-on experience in Salesforce development and customization.
* Proficiency in Apex, including triggers, classes, Batch Apex, and asynchronous processing.
* Hands-on experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC).
* Strong knowledge of SOQL and Salesforce data modeling.
* Experience developing and consuming REST/SOAP APIs and implementing Salesforce integrations.
* Good understanding of Salesforce Administration, security, automation, and platform capabilities.
* Experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting enterprise Salesforce solutions.
* Knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, debugging, and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Valid Salesforce Developer certification — mandatory.
* Platform Developer I (PD1).
* Lightning Web Components (LWC).
* Salesforce Administration.
* Strong proficiency in Apex and SOQL.
* Experience with Salesforce customization and integrations.
* Ability to work the mandatory shift of 5:00 PM PDT – 2:00 AM PDT.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Experience with enterprise Salesforce implementations.
* Familiarity with Git and version control systems.
* Knowledge of Salesforce deployment practices and release management.
* Understanding of Salesforce development standards, code quality, and performance optimization.
* Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud and Sales Cloud.

**Desired Attributes**

* A hands-on developer capable of independently delivering high-quality Salesforce solutions.
* Strong ownership of development tasks, troubleshooting, and production support.
* Ability to analyze complex technical issues and implement effective solutions.
* Commitment to coding standards, platform security, and maintainable development practices.
* Strong collaboration skills when working with cross-functional teams.
* Flexibility to support client requirements within the specified working hours.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
PYAAS is a DPIIT-recognized, FSSAI-licensed dairy startup that brings full traceability to India’s milk supply chain. Every PYAAS pack carries a QR code that shows the farms involved, the farmer’s name, batch composition, fat and SNF levels, adulteration checks, and time of milking and chilling. The company sources milk from carefully audited family farms in Gonda, Uttar Pradesh, and provides farmers with transparent pricing and direct access to city buyers. PYAAS currently offers single-farm and family-farm milk for homes in Lucknow, small-batch Bilona cow ghee across India, and doorstep Parag dairy delivery via its Android and iOS app. Through the PYAAS Digital Agent Network, local milk vendors and shop owners serve their neighborhoods using the PYAAS platform, connecting dairy brands, farmers, and consumers with verified records.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time Lead Software Engineer role based in Noida, structured as a hybrid position that combines on-site work with some flexibility for working from home. The Lead Software Engineer will design, develop, and maintain back-end systems and services that power the PYAAS app, digital storefront, and agent network platform. Responsibilities include leading the technical architecture, writing clean and scalable code, reviewing contributions from other engineers, and ensuring system reliability, performance, and security. The role involves collaborating closely with product, operations, and data teams to translate business needs into technical solutions, integrating third-party services, and optimizing workflows for farmers, agents, and end consumers. The Lead Software Engineer will also mentor team members, establish best practices, and contribute to the long-term technology roadmap.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, and systems design.
* Proficiency in Back-End Web Development and Software Development for scalable, high-availability applications.
* Hands-on experience with Programming and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) in one or more modern languages (e.g., Java, Python, Go, or similar).
* Experience leading engineering projects or teams, with the ability to mentor and guide other developers.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, APIs, relational and/or NoSQL databases, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Comfort working in a startup environment, with strong problem-solving skills and ownership mindset.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in e-commerce, logistics, or agritech platforms is an advantage.

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer
description:
**About Clearwater Analytics**
Clearwater Analytics is a global SaaS leader in automated investment data aggregation, reconciliation, accounting, and reporting. Serving the world's largest asset managers, insurance companies, and corporations, Clearwater processes trillions of dollars in assets daily. Our Beacon Risk & Pricing Platform delivers real-time risk analytics and pricing intelligence — powered by reliable, high-quality market data and reference data pipelines at the core.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Beacon Risk & Pricing Platform team. In this role you will design, build, and operate mission-critical market data and reference data pipelines that feed our real-time pricing and risk engines. You will work closely with quant researchers, data vendors, and platform engineers to ensure that high-quality, low-latency data flows reliably across the entire investment analytics stack.
  
  
This is a high-impact, high-ownership role. You will make architectural decisions, mentor peers, and directly influence how Clearwater ingests, normalises, and distributes market data at scale.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Market & Reference Data Pipelines
  
  

* Design and build scalable Python-based ETL/ELT pipelines ingesting multi-asset market data (equities, fixed income, derivatives, FX, commodities) from vendors such as Bloomberg, Refinitiv/LSEG, ICE Data Services, and FactSet.
* Engineer and maintain a robust securities master (reference data) system covering identifiers (CUSIP, ISIN, SEDOL, FIGI), corporate actions, instrument attributes, and classification hierarchies.
* Build real-time and batch data feeds using AWS-native services (Kinesis, MSK/Kafka, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions) with SLAs measured in milliseconds to seconds.
* Implement data quality frameworks — completeness checks, anomaly detection, stale-data alerting, and automated reconciliation against authoritative vendor sources.

Platform & Infrastructure
  
  

* Architect cloud-native, event-driven data infrastructure on AWS (S3, Redshift, RDS Aurora, DynamoDB, ElastiCache) with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform / CDK).
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and ensure deployments are automated, tested, and observable (CloudWatch, Datadog, OpenTelemetry).
* Drive schema design, data modelling, and partitioning strategies that balance query performance against storage cost at petabyte scale.

**Required**
**What You'll Bring**

* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 4 years building production data pipelines in Python (Pandas, PySpark, asyncio, or equivalent).
* Deep hands-on experience with AWS data services: S3, Glue, Lambda, Kinesis / MSK, Redshift, RDS, Step Functions.
* Strong understanding of market data domains — pricing, corporate actions, identifier mapping, instrument reference data — from a financial services or fintech context.
* Experience designing and operating high-availability, low-latency streaming and batch pipelines in production.
* Proficiency in SQL and data modelling for analytical and operational workloads.
* Familiarity with data quality patterns: schema validation, reconciliation, SLA monitoring, dead-letter queues, and alerting.
* Strong communication skills — you write clear design docs, run productive tech discussions, and collaborate across disciplines.

**Preferred**

* Experience with securities master / reference data systems: CUSIP, ISIN, SEDOL, FIGI, and corporate action processing.
* Prior integration with major market data vendors (Bloomberg B-PIPE / SAPI, Refinitiv/LSEG Elektron, ICE Data Services).
* Knowledge of Apache Airflow or similar workflow orchestration tools.
* Experience with Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or other open table formats for data lake management.
* Familiarity with risk or pricing platforms in asset management or insurance investment operations.
* AWS Professional or Specialty certifications (Data Analytics, Solutions Architect).

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About the role**

As a
**Forward Deployed Engineer at**
SquadStack.ai, you’ll work on building and evolving production-grade Voice AI systems that customers actively use.

You’ll operate close to real deployments - identifying gaps surfaced by live usage, designing solutions, and shipping them into production. Some work moves fast; some work is planned and iterative. What matters is that priorities are driven by real customer outcomes, not by work defined quarters in advance.

You’ll leverage the SquadStack platform to configure, extend, and build AI-native workflows, while writing production-quality code where needed. You’ll work in a small pod alongside Customer Success and AI PM partners, owning technical execution end-to-end.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer reality -
**with a strong emphasis on code quality, system reliability, and long-term leverage over one-off fixes.**

***Apply even if you’re only 70% sure. The conversation itself is valuable.***

**What you'll do**

You’ll work in a
**small pod**
(CSM / AI PM handles customer communication; you handle technical execution), solving problems that block customer success but aren’t yet on the product roadmap
**.**

**Your engineering work includes:**

* Building custom integrations, tools, and AI workflows that unblock customer needs
* Designing and refining AI prompts, RAG systems, and LLM-based solutions
* Writing production-quality code (Python / JavaScript) with the same standards as core engineering
* Deciding whether solutions should remain custom, become reusable, or move into the core product
* Collaborating with core engineering teams to upstream learnings and reduce future friction.

**What you will
*not*
do:**

* Run customer calls
* Own accounts
* Chase stakeholders
* Do repetitive support work

**This is NOT solutions engineering**

You do not deliver one-off scripts and move on

Every solution is evaluated on leverage:

* Can this be reused?
* Can this become a product primitive?
* Can this eliminate future manual work?

Custom work is acceptable only if the business makes sense, or it is experimental, where we’d learn something new.

Strong solutions frequently get upstreamed into:

* Core platform capabilities
* Reusable internal tooling
* Product roadmap items owned by core engineering

**Your success is measured by reduced future friction - not by how many customers you personally unblock.**

**Code quality:**
Same high bar

**Technical difficulty:**
Often harder - real-world problems are messier and more near-term in nature than planned roadmaps

**Two engineering tracks - both valuable:**

**Core Engineering:**

* Product Roadmap
* Roadmap and sprint-driven
* Deep, well-scoped, long-lived
* Platform & system optimisation
* Slower, abstracted
* Platform Abstractions & scalability

**Customer Impact (This Role):**

* Day-to-day customer usage & success signals
* Signal-driven; flexible planning
* Broad, evolving, discovery-heavy
* Unblocking + generalising into scale
* Immediate, real-world
* Reduction of future friction & repeat issues

**Both are real engineering. Both lead to staff or lead roles. Both are equally respected.**

**Why ambitious engineers choose this role**

**🚀Unmatched learning velocity:**

* Build with cutting-edge AI (LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG) in production
* Learn what actually makes products succeed in real markets
* Develop full-stack skills alongside business judgment

**⚡Real Autonomy:**

* Choose your own tools and approaches
* Ship when ready - not when a sprint ends
* Direct influence on the product roadmap & org metrics via real usage

**💪Career acceleration:**

Engineers from this track commonly become:

* Product Engineers who can both build and prioritise
* Technical Leads who deeply understand customer reality
* Founding Engineers or CTOs at startups with a complete skill stack

**🎯Immediate impact:**

* Direct feedback from real usage
* Clear line from your work to business outcomes

**What we’re looking for**

**Technical baseline:**

* Strong programming fundamentals (Python / JavaScript preferred,
  **but talent > language)**
* Comfort with ambiguity and incomplete requirements
* Curiosity about AI / ML in production (expertise is a bonus, not a requirement)

**Mindset fit:**

* **Ownership:**
  Takes end-to-end responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks; drives problems to resolution even across unclear boundaries.
* **Pragmatic:**
  Focused on solutions that work now
* **Curious:**
  Wants to understand the “why” behind problems
* **Entrepreneurial:**
  Treats technical problems as business problems
* **Communicative:**
  Can translate technical decisions into a business context
* **AI Native:**
  Exposure to AI systems or prompt & context engineering.

**Should I apply?**

**YES, if you:**

* Want to work on AI-native products at the frontier
* Enjoy variety - no two weeks look the same
* Care about understanding the “why” behind what you build
* Prefer building solutions over strictly following specs
* I am curious about how engineering decisions affect business outcomes

**MAYBE NOT, if you:**

* Prefer predictable, tightly defined work
* Dislike exposure to business or customer context
* Need detailed specs to be productive
* Prefer large teams over small, autonomous pods
* Want to avoid ambiguity or rapid context-switching

**Day-to-day reality**

No two weeks look the same, but a typical flow might look like this:

* **Monday:**
  Pod sync to review customer progress and technical blockers. One issue stands out - a workflow the product doesn’t fully support yet.
* **Tuesday:**
  Prototype a solution (integration, tool, or AI workflow). Loop in core engineering early if it looks reusable.
* **Wednesday:**
  Refine the solution - edge cases, AI prompt behaviour, reliability. Decide whether this should remain custom or be generalised.
* **Thursday:**
  Ship to production. Monitor real usage. Iterate quickly if needed.
* **Friday:**
  Share learnings, move on to the next.

**Quick Check?**

* **Freedom level:**
  High
* **Bureaucracy:**
  Low
* **Learning curve:**
  Steep
* **Impact visibility:**
  Immediate and measurable

**Logistics**

* **Location:**
  Noida
* **Compensation:**
  Competitive!
* **Joining:**
  ASAP!

**Why should you consider us seriously?**

* We believe that long-term, people over product and profits, prioritize culture over everything else.
* We are a well-balanced team of experienced entrepreneurs and are backed by top investors across India and Silicon Valley (Chiratae Ventures, Blume Ventures, Abstract Ventures, Emergent Ventures; Senior execs at Google, Square, Genpact & Flipkart; Co-founders of Infosys, Snapdeal, Slideshare, Zomato, etc.)
* Freedom and Responsibility 🦅

SquadStack is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.***

title: SDE I - Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
🚀
**We’re Hiring: Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) | AI, Agentic Systems & Software Engineering**

Are you a strong software engineer who enjoys solving
**ambiguous, real-world business problems**
and turning them into production-ready technology?

We’re looking for
**Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs)**
who combine:

💻 Strong software engineering

🤖 AI & Agentic Engineering

🧠 Product thinking

🔧 Hands-on problem solving

🤝 Customer & stakeholder collaboration

🏗️ End-to-end ownership

🔹 What You’ll Do

As an FDE, you’ll take ownership of complex problems — from
**discovery → solution design → prototype → implementation → production deployment → continuous improvement**
.

You will:

• Work directly with customers, product teams, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to understand complex problems and translate them into technical solutions.

• Build production-grade applications, backend services, APIs, integrations, and AI-powered workflows.

• Design and develop
**AI agents and agentic workflows**
using LLMs, tool/function calling, APIs, RAG, MCP, and emerging AI technologies.

• Integrate solutions with internal platforms and external enterprise systems.

• Rapidly prototype ideas and convert successful prototypes into scalable production systems.

• Debug complex issues across applications, APIs, infrastructure, data, models, and third-party integrations.

• Make pragmatic architectural decisions balancing
**scalability, reliability, security, latency, cost, and time-to-market**
.

• Determine when to use deterministic software vs. AI/LLM-based approaches.

• Implement guardrails, authorization, observability, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop mechanisms for AI systems.

• Work effectively with incomplete requirements and evolving customer needs.

• Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

🔹 Strong Software Engineering Fundamentals

We’re looking for hands-on experience with:

• Python, Java, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, or equivalent

• APIs, databases, distributed systems, and backend architecture

• Production-grade applications and services

• Debugging and troubleshooting

• Authentication & authorization

• Security, scalability, reliability, observability, and performance

• Quickly understanding unfamiliar codebases, APIs, and systems

🔹 AI & Agentic Engineering

Hands-on experience or strong practical understanding of:

• Large Language Models (LLMs)

• LLM APIs & SDKs

• AI agents & agentic workflows

• Tool/function calling

• Prompt & context engineering

• Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

• Model evaluation & quality measurement

• Guardrails & hallucination mitigation

• Agent state, memory & orchestration

• Human-in-the-loop workflows

• Model cost, latency & accuracy trade-offs

Experience with
**OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, LangGraph, MCP**
, or similar AI/agent frameworks is highly desirable.

💡 We value engineers who understand
**when NOT to use an LLM**
just as much as those who know how to use one.

🔹 Enterprise Integration & Architecture

Experience with some of the following is highly desirable:

• REST / GraphQL APIs

• Webhooks & event-driven architectures

• Messaging / queueing systems

• SQL / NoSQL databases

• OAuth / OIDC & enterprise authentication

• SaaS & enterprise system integrations

• Cloud platforms & containerized environments

• Microservices & distributed systems

🔹 What Makes a Strong FDE?

We’re particularly interested in engineers who:

• Are comfortable operating with ambiguity and incomplete requirements.

• Ask the right questions before jumping into implementation.

• Can independently convert a business problem into a working technical solution.

• Are equally comfortable discussing requirements with customers and debugging code with engineers.

• Have strong product judgment and focus on solving the underlying problem — not just implementing requested features.

• Can rapidly learn unfamiliar technologies and systems.

• Prefer building and validating solutions over producing lengthy theoretical designs.

• Take end-to-end ownership and remain accountable after the solution reaches production.

• Balance engineering quality with practical delivery timelines.

• Communicate complex technical concepts clearly and confidently.

🔹 Required Experience

**1–3 years of software engineering experience**
for FDE roles.

Additionally:

• Experience delivering customer-facing or enterprise solutions

• Experience taking a product/system from concept or prototype to production

• Experience in fast-moving product, platform, fintech, SaaS, AI, or enterprise technology environments

• Experience working directly with enterprise customers or business stakeholders is an advantage

• Experience building AI-powered products or production agentic systems is a strong advantage

The successful candidate should be capable of:

**Understanding the problem → Designing the solution → Writing the code → Integrating systems → Deploying → Debugging production issues → Improving the product**

👉
**The ability to build is fundamental to this role.**

🔹 Ideal Candidate

The ideal FDE is a combination of:

**Strong Software Engineer + Pragmatic Solution Architect + Product Thinker + Customer-Facing Problem Solver**

You should enjoy being given a difficult problem with
**no obvious solution**
and being responsible for figuring out:

**What needs to be built → How to build it → How to deploy it → How to make it work in the real world.**

🔹 What You Should Be Comfortable With

🏢 Working from the office
**5 days a week**

⚡ Working in a fast-paced, high-impact engineering environment

🚀 Challenging conventional thinking and driving innovation

🎯 Taking end-to-end ownership of complex problems

🔹 What We Value

🚀
**You Take the Shot**

Make decisions with confidence and execute with speed.

🎯
**You Own It**

Act like the CEO of your work — taking complete ownership and accountability.

🎨
**You Craft with Pride**

Continuously learn, strive for excellence, and take pride in building secure, scalable, world-class products.

We are looking for highly skilled Product Engineers – Java with up to 3 years of experience to join the engineering team at RunnTV. We have 2 open positions for engineers who are passionate about building scalable, high-performance products and solving real-world technology challenges.

You will work on the technology powering RunnTV's OTT streaming platform and PlayStudio, our media technology platform, building backend services, APIs and scalable systems that support millions of users and a growing streaming ecosystem.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of meaningful engineering challenges, work closely with product and business teams, and contribute directly to building products in a fast-growing media and technology company.

**Preference will be given to candidates from premier engineering institutions, including IITs, NITs and other reputed engineering colleges.**

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Backend Development: Design, develop, test and deploy robust, scalable backend solutions using Java and related technologies.
2. Microservices & API Development: Build and maintain scalable microservices and RESTful APIs for seamless integration across our platforms.
3. Performance Optimization: Improve application performance, reduce latency and ensure high availability and reliability.
4. Database Management: Design, optimize and maintain SQL and NoSQL databases, ensuring data integrity and scalability.
5. Product Engineering: Work on features and services that power our OTT streaming platform and media technology products.
6. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, business and engineering teams to translate requirements into effective technical solutions.
7. Code Quality: Follow clean coding practices, write maintainable code and contribute to code reviews and automated testing.
8. CI/CD & Deployment: Participate in build, deployment and release processes, using modern development and DevOps practices.
9. Troubleshooting & Debugging: Identify and resolve technical issues, investigate root causes and improve system reliability.
10. Continuous Improvement: Explore new technologies, improve existing systems and contribute to engineering best practices.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

1. 1–3 years of relevant software development experience, with strong proficiency in Java.
2. Strong understanding of Core Java, OOP concepts and data structures.
3. Hands-on experience with Spring Boot, Hibernate and RESTful APIs.
4. Understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems.
5. Experience working with SQL and/or NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or Redis.
6. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP or Azure.
7. Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
8. Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes is desirable.
9. Knowledge of multithreading, caching, performance optimization and message brokers such as Kafka or RabbitMQ is an advantage.
10. Strong problem-solving, analytical and debugging skills.
11. Ability to write clean, efficient and maintainable code.
12. A strong sense of ownership, willingness to learn and ability to work in a fast-paced product engineering environment.

Prior experience in media, OTT or streaming technology is an added advantage, but not mandatory.

If you are a passionate Java engineer who wants to build impactful products, solve challenging engineering problems and grow with a high-growth technology company, we would love to hear from you.

Send your resume and a short cover letter to: hiring@runn.tv

**Subject Line:**
Application – Product Engineer (Java)

**Please note:**
This is a Work from Office role based in Noida. We are hiring for 2 positions, and candidates with a maximum of 3 years of relevant experience are eligible to apply.

**About RunnTV**

RunnTV (runn.tv) is India's first independent and fastest-growing FAST (Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television) platform, delivering free entertainment to Indian audiences through 24x7 thematic and curated channels.

We are building RunnTV with a vision to create the biggest free entertainment experience destination for Indians across the globe.

title: Digital Systems Lead – Construction Site Apps
description:
About us

KV Developers is part of ReaRCo, a restructuring and turnaround group that works on practical solutions to real-world problems. We are building a technology-driven construction company and are developing a range of in-house digital tools for our projects, starting at our residential project in Greater Noida West.

About the role

Our site already runs on in-house mobile apps for snagging and de-snagging of flats, daily monitoring of works, labour and contractors, and reports for management, built on Google Workspace and AppSheet with scripted automation. More tools will follow.

We are looking for one person to own the day-to-day running of these apps: making changes, keeping the data clean, testing before release, training site staff and contractors, and making sure the apps are actually used on site. You will work directly with the founder and the project leadership. Most technical design and coding is prepared with AI tools; your job is to turn decisions into working, well-tested tools quickly and get them adopted on site.

What you will do

- Configure and release changes to the apps (AppSheet) and their data (Google Sheets); keep a change log.

- Own master data: users and logins, roles, contractors, locations, work items and assignments.

- Test every change on a test copy before release, and run field tests with site teams.

- Train engineers, foremen, contractors and vendors in Hindi and English, and follow up until the apps are used daily.

- Track adoption and data quality, and send a short written summary each evening.

- Collect feedback from site and management into one list, and prepare specifications with AI tools for decisions.

- Act as second administrator for Google Workspace and related accounts; keep access, backups and documentation in order.

- Support a planned move of the data to a SQL database with a senior technical reviewer.

What we are looking for

- 4 to 8 years in residential or commercial construction as a civil, QA/QC or planning engineer, or a no-code developer with real site exposure.

- Confident with Google Sheets and at least one no-code or low-code tool (AppSheet preferred); able to read simple scripts.

- Comfortable working with AI tools (for example ChatGPT or Claude) to draft, check and document work.

- Methodical about testing, data and documentation.

- Fluent in Hindi and English; able to train site staff and hold contractors to a routine.

- Discreet with confidential data and systems.

Good to have: Apps Script or JavaScript, SQL, Looker Studio, MS Project or Primavera, experience rolling out a site app or ERP module.

Location and hours: at our site in Greater Noida West, Monday to Saturday; hybrid once the rollout settles.

Reports to: the founder, working closely with the project head on site and the planning head.

Compensation: competitive, in line with experience.

To apply: please include one example of a tool, app, sheet or process you built or rolled out, and what changed as a result.

title: IoT Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced
**IoT Engineer**
with 2–5 years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, integrating, and deploying end-to-end IoT solutions.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working across
**IoT devices, sensors, embedded systems, communication protocols, APIs, cloud platforms, databases, and backend systems**
to build reliable IoT solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Design, develop, integrate, and deploy end-to-end IoT solutions.

• Work with IoT devices, sensors, actuators, microcontrollers, and edge devices.

• Develop solutions using ESP32, ESP8266, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, STM32, or equivalent platforms.

• Implement communication using MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, BLE, Wi-Fi, Modbus, and other IoT protocols.

• Develop reliable device-to-cloud communication and data transmission.

• Integrate IoT devices with REST APIs, backend services, databases, and cloud platforms.

• Work with AWS IoT, Azure IoT, Google Cloud, or equivalent platforms.

• Develop and maintain IoT data pipelines for collecting, processing, and storing device data.

• Develop or integrate IoT monitoring dashboards for device status, sensor data, alerts, and performance.

• Troubleshoot hardware, firmware, connectivity, network, API, and data-related issues.

• Perform testing, debugging, validation, and deployment of IoT devices and applications.

• Monitor deployed devices and identify connectivity, performance, and data accuracy issues.

• Implement device authentication, secure communication, and basic IoT security practices.

• Work with Linux-based systems and edge computing environments.

• Maintain technical documentation related to IoT architecture, devices, APIs, configurations, and deployments.

• Collaborate with backend, software, AI/ML, and operations teams.

• Evaluate new IoT technologies and recommend suitable hardware, protocols, and platforms.

**Required Skills & Experience**

• 2–5 years of professional experience in IoT development or integration.

• Strong understanding of IoT architecture and device-to-cloud communication.

• Hands-on experience with ESP32, ESP8266, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, STM32, or equivalent platforms.

• Strong knowledge of MQTT and REST APIs.

• Good understanding of TCP/IP, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, and HTTP/HTTPS.

• Programming experience in Python, C/C++, or Embedded C.

• Hands-on experience with sensors, actuators, GPIO, UART, SPI, I2C, and serial communication.

• Experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or equivalent databases.

• Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, or another cloud platform.

• Good understanding of Linux and command-line tools.

• Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Good to Have**

• AWS IoT Core or Azure IoT Hub experience.

• Experience with LoRaWAN, Zigbee, NB-IoT, 4G/5G, or cellular IoT.

• Experience with Node-RED, Grafana, or similar monitoring platforms.

• Experience with edge computing and Raspberry Pi/Linux-based gateways.

• Knowledge of Docker and containerized deployments.

• Understanding of IoT security, authentication, encryption, and secure communication.

• Experience with OTA firmware updates and device management.

• Exposure to Edge AI / AI at the Edge.

• Experience in industrial IoT, logistics, asset tracking, fleet monitoring, or supply-chain applications.

**Education**

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, IoT, or a related field.

• Strong hands-on IoT project experience will be considered an advantage.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate should be able to independently understand and implement the complete IoT flow:

**Sensor/Device → Embedded System → Connectivity → MQTT/API → Edge/Cloud → Backend → Database → Dashboard/Alerts**

The candidate should be comfortable working across
**hardware, firmware, networking, cloud, and software integration**
, rather than focusing on only one component.

**Key Skills**

IoT | MQTT | ESP32 | Raspberry Pi | Arduino | Python | C/C++ | Embedded Systems | Sensors | REST APIs | AWS | Azure | GCP | TCP/IP | Wi-Fi | BLE | Modbus | Linux | Cloud | Databases | Edge Computing

We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

* Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.

* Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.

* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* Must Have skills : AWS Full stack Java required.
* Typescript

title: AI Agent Development Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**In this Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
In this role, you will help shape the future of intelligent engineering and power plant operations by developing hands-on AI/ML and agent-based solutions that simplify engineering work, increase productivity, and unlock new operational capabilities.
  
  
You will build intelligent tools and AI agents that automate control logic generation, graphics configuration, reporting, and engineering workflows, enabling plant engineers to focus on higher-value innovation. By analyzing control system and operational data, you will uncover patterns, develop predictive capabilities, and deliver data-driven decision support for real-world power plant environments.
  
  

* Apply AI-based anomaly detection, diagnostics, and decision-support solutions to real power-plant operational challenges.
* Translate plant operating behavior, control logic, alarms, and historian trends into practical AI use cases and agent workflows.
* Work with time-series operational data from DCS/SCADA and plant historians (preferably Emerson Ovation) to identify abnormal patterns, degradation, and performance losses.
* Collaborate with sales and marketing,and reliability teams to validate AI insights against real plant conditions.
* Support development and tuning of AI/analytics models using Python and data tools (focus on application rather than algorithm research).
* Integrate AI outputs into dashboards, alerts, and engineering workflows without impacting plant safety or control integrity.
* Test, validate, and monitor AI solutions in live or near-real plant environments, ensuring reliability and low false-alarm rates.
* Continuously improve AI performance using operational feedback, historical fault data, and domain knowledge.
* Troubleshoot deployed analytics/AI tools and coordinate improvements with software or data teams.

**Who you Are:**
We are looking for a proactive professional who excels in dynamic, fast-paced environments. You demonstrate exceptional initiative, confidently tackling complex challenges in power plant control and optimization. With a strong commitment to innovation and excellence, you set ambitious goals and uphold the highest standards in every project.
  
  
**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Control Systems, Power Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 2–8 years of experience in coal-fired, combined-cycle, or utility power plants with strong knowledge of plant operations, control processes, and performance optimization.
* Hands-on experience with DCS platforms, preferably Emerson Ovation, including control logic, alarm management, plant monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of power plant systems such as boilers, turbines, generators, combustion controls, and balance-of-plant operations.
* Experience developing AI-powered applications using Python, including data processing, API integration, and workflow automation.
* Knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI Agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar.
* Ability to translate power plant operational knowledge and procedures into AI Agent use cases and intelligent automation solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across operations, engineering, and software development teams.

**Preferred Qualifications That Make You Stand Out:**

* Experience with Emerson Ovation DCS or other power plant control systems (ABB, Honeywell, Siemens, GE, Yokogawa).
* Hands-on experience developing AI Agents, operator assistants, troubleshooting tools, or knowledge management solutions for industrial applications.
* Knowledge of machine learning, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and time-series analytics.
* Familiarity with vector databases, cloud AI platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), and industrial data integration.
* Passion for applying AI and automation technologies to improve power plant operations, reliability, and performance.

**Our Culture & Commitment to You:**
At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
  
  
We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing flexible, competitive benefits plans to meet you and your family’s physical, mental, financial, and social needs. We provide a variety of medical insurance plans, with dental and vision coverage, Employee Assistance Program, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
  
  
**About Us**
**WHY EMERSON**
**Our Commitment to Our People**
At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.
  
  
We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.
  
  
At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.

Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability.

title: Staff Software Development Engineer
description:
The Staff Software Development Engineer role within Clearwater’s Agentic Client Interactions & Orchestration (ACIO) is a senior technical leadership position focused on architecting, designing, and delivering large-scale distributed systems that power critical financial reporting and analytics. This role requires deep expertise in scalable system design, agentic architecture, cloud-native platforms, and high-performance data processing.
  
  
You will play a key role in shaping the technical direction, ensuring architectural excellence, and enabling teams to build robust, maintainable systems that support Clearwater’s commitment to industry-leading financial reporting solutions. Senior engineers at this level are expected to think strategically, lead through influence, and drive innovations that scale across products and teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Architecture & Design Leadership**

* Own the end-to-end architecture of Clearwater ACIO systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance in large-scale financial data processing.
* Define, document, and communicate architectural standards, patterns, and best practices for distributed systems.
* Evaluate and implement design patterns for fault tolerance, high availability, and horizontal scalability.
* Collaborate with product managers, data architects, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into system-level designs and technical roadmaps.
* Conduct architectural reviews and provide engineering guidance to ensure alignment with strategic technology vision.

**Technical Strategy & Delivery**

* Lead the technical strategy, operational excellence, and professional delivery across multiple domains in Clearwater.
* Drive improvements in system observability, maintainability, and deployment automation.
* Ensure designs and implementations meet security, compliance, and performance benchmarks.
* Oversee execution of multi-team, multi-service projects, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery at scale.

**Mentorship & Collaboration**

* Mentor senior and mid-level engineers in architecture thinking, technical design, and distributed systems development.
* Build strong relationships with teams across divisions to facilitate cross-system integration and shared technology improvements.

**Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging architectures, and cloud technologies.
* Identify opportunities for re-architecting or optimizing existing systems to improve throughput, latency, and cost-efficiency.
* Foster a culture of innovation, scalability, and engineering excellence across FO Reporting and broader Clearwater teams.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Proven architecture and design expertise in large-scale distributed systems, preferably in financial or analytics platforms.
* Exceptional leadership skills and ability to lead through influence as a technical architect or senior tech lead.
* Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and data streaming platforms (Kafka, AWS Kinesis, etc.).
* Hands-on experience with public cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), including scaling, cost optimization, and multi-region deployments.
* Proficiency in one or more modern languages (Java, Python, Go, or similar) with deep understanding of concurrency, memory management, and performance tuning.
* Strong understanding of distributed data storage, database scaling, and query optimization techniques.
* Worked on agentic conversational UX design and architecture.
* Developed and deployed systems with complex SLAs in production environments serving high-volume traffic/data.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to clearly convey architectural decisions and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Commitment to continuous technical learning, improvement, and community knowledge sharing.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical discipline.
* 10+ years of professional software development experience; 5+ years acting in an architecture or principal engineering capacity.
* Track record of designing and implementing enterprise-grade distributed systems and owning them through full lifecycle (design → build → deploy → maintain).

title: Sr Embedded Linux Engineer

* BSP & Kernel Management: Develop, configure, and maintain Board Support Packages (BSP), bootloaders (U-Boot), and Linux kernel drivers.

* Security & Compliance: Implement security measures such as hardening, patching, and secure boot implementations.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* Linux Expertise: Deep knowledge of Linux kernel, file systems, and user space development.
* Embedded Build Systems: Proven experience with Yocto Project, and familiarity with Ansible and Aptly tools.
* Programming Languages: Proficiency in C, C++, and scripting languages such as Python or Bash.
* Version Control: Strong experience with Git.
* Hardware Knowledge: Familiarity with ARM/x86 architectures, bootloaders (U-Boot), and hardware interfaces (USB, PCIe, UART, I2C, SPI).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with containerization at the edge.
* Knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP stack).
* Experience supporting large complex systems with multiple operating systems running simultaneously in a single device.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
**Principal Software Engineer, Foundational APIs**
Location: Noida, India
  
  
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, and collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn, and pursue meaningful outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values: Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like what we are saying, keep reading!
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
SimCorp is establishing a Foundational APIs capability to make core business data and functionality easier to access securely, consistently, and reliably across our products and solutions.
  
  
As a Principal Software Engineer, you will play a central role in shaping this capability. You will help define and build stable, reusable API contracts that enable product experiences, integrations, workflows, clients, and approved AI solutions to interact with SimCorp’s business capabilities without needing to understand the complexity of the underlying systems.
  
  
This is not a role focused only on defining standards or producing architecture. You will work hands-on with engineers, architects, product leaders, domain experts, and existing platform teams to turn technical direction into production-quality software. You will help the team reuse existing API infrastructure and domain capabilities where appropriate, progressively abstract legacy implementations, and avoid creating unnecessary layers or duplication.
  
  
You will join a newly established team in India and help deliver its first production capabilities. The role provides an opportunity to influence architecture, engineering practices, technical direction, and the way API capabilities are developed and adopted across SimCorp.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Lead the technical design and implementation of SimCorp’s Foundational APIs.
* Work hands-on with engineering teams to build secure, scalable, reliable, and maintainable services using C#/.NET and Microsoft Azure.
* Translate real consumer and business needs into focused API capabilities with clear outcomes and measurable release criteria.
* Design stable and reusable API contracts that represent meaningful business capabilities rather than exposing the complexity of underlying systems.
* Collaborate with domain experts to establish clear and consistent meaning for shared concepts such as portfolios, positions, transactions, cash, instruments, and settlement information.
* Evaluate and make pragmatic decisions across REST, GraphQL, messaging, and other integration approaches based on the needs of each capability.
* Make API behavior explicit across business dates, data freshness, pagination, filtering, precision, missing information, partial results, and error handling.
* Design for distributed-system concerns including latency, partial failures, retries, idempotency, concurrency, resilience, and source-system availability.
* Help separate stable consumer contracts from underlying implementations so that systems can evolve or be progressively replaced without unnecessary consumer impact.
* Assess and reuse existing API frameworks, gateways, services, integration solutions, and domain capabilities before introducing new abstractions or infrastructure.
* Work with legacy systems and supported interfaces, using adapters and incremental modernization patterns where appropriate.
* Contribute directly to critical implementation areas, technical spikes, reference implementations, automated tests, deployment pipelines, and complex problem resolution.
* Establish and promote engineering practices covering clean code, automated testing, contract testing, compatibility validation, security, observability, CI/CD, and production readiness.
* Review architecture, technical designs, and code, providing constructive feedback that raises the engineering quality of the team.
* Lead by example, helping engineers decompose complex problems into incremental, testable, and releasable capabilities.
* Create reusable implementation patterns, templates, documentation, and examples that make it easier for other teams to contribute consistently.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management, Architecture, Platform, Security, Data, and domain engineering teams across SimCorp.
* Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, dependencies, limitations, and risks clearly to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.
* Mentor engineers and strengthen technical leadership within the team through design discussions, pairing, code reviews, and practical engineering guidance.
* Continuously learn and develop yourself, the team, and the Foundational APIs capability.

**What We Value**

* Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed is less important. We expect you to be strong in several of the following areas and interested in learning the rest:
* Extensive experience designing and building production software using C# and .NET.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Azure, cloud-native architecture, and Azure DevOps.
* Demonstrated experience designing and developing REST APIs and distributed services.
* Experience with GraphQL, messaging, or event-driven architecture is valuable, but not mandatory.
* Strong understanding of API design principles, including contract design, versioning, backward compatibility, pagination, filtering, error handling, and documentation.
* Experience building observable and supportable services using logs, metrics, tracing, health monitoring, and operational diagnostics.
* Strong understanding of distributed-system challenges such as latency, resilience, partial failure, concurrency, idempotency, consistency, and safe retry behavior.
* Experience creating and managing CI/CD pipelines and automated quality controls.
* Strong automated-testing skills, including unit, integration, API, contract, and end-to-end testing.
* Experience with relational databases and SQL.
* Experience applying Domain-Driven Design or similar techniques to define clear business capabilities and service boundaries.
* Experience modernizing legacy systems through adapters, incremental refactoring, progressive migration, or cloud adoption.
* Ability to simplify complex architectures and create maintainable solutions without introducing unnecessary abstraction.
* Ability to evaluate existing systems and frameworks critically before deciding to build something new.
* Strong architectural judgment combined with the willingness and ability to contribute hands-on to implementation.
* Ability to balance immediate delivery needs with long-term maintainability, reliability, and contract stability.
* Ability to mentor and guide engineers toward technical excellence and effective delivery without becoming a bottleneck for decisions.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across product, business, architecture, and engineering domains.
* Experience working in a multinational product-development organization.
* Interest in learning the investment-management domain and understanding the business meaning behind the APIs being developed.
* Readiness to learn relevant SimCorp technologies, frameworks, and legacy environments where required.
* An M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field is valuable but not essential.
* Good English communication skills, both written and spoken.

**AI-ENABLED DEVELOPMENT**

* Use approved AI tools fluently as part of everyday engineering, discovery, development, testing, and documentation workflows.
* Critically evaluate AI-generated code, designs, tests, and documentation for correctness, security, maintainability, and architectural fit.
* Help the team use AI responsibly, including understanding when AI-generated output can accelerate delivery and when deeper engineering review is required.
* Identify opportunities where AI can reduce low-value work, improve developer productivity, and accelerate prototyping and technical discovery.
* Help ensure that APIs intended for approved AI consumers apply the same identity, authorization, business rules, auditability, and operational controls as other consumers.

**FURTHERMORE, WE VALUE THAT YOU**

* Are curious about complex business and technical problems and willing to examine assumptions before proposing a solution.
* Are comfortable working in an evolving area where business meaning, source-system ownership, implementation, and priorities may be distributed across multiple teams.
* Can influence technical direction across organizational boundaries without relying solely on formal authority.
* Take ownership of outcomes and remain engaged from discovery through implementation and production operation.
* Challenge unnecessary complexity and help teams focus on the smallest useful capability that can be validated with a real consumer.
* Learn through experimentation and use insights from both successes and failures to improve future decisions.
* Can identify technical debt, architectural risk, and operational weaknesses and help the team address them deliberately.
* Value collaboration and knowledge sharing and actively help other engineers grow.
* Combine strong technical opinions with openness to evidence, alternative perspectives, and changing circumstances.

**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy: We ask you to work two days a week from the office. You may work remotely on the other days or work from the office if that is your preference.
* Culture: An inclusive and diverse company culture where different perspectives and expertise are valued.
* Work-life balance: We believe that a sustainable balance between professional and personal responsibilities helps everyone perform at their best.
* Empowerment: We believe all voices are valuable and should be heard. You will be involved in shaping our technical direction and ways of working.
* Career and growth: SimCorp provides opportunities for professional development and supports individual career paths based on your strengths and aspirations.
* Innovation: You will have opportunities to contribute to engineering improvements, technical modernization, and strategic capabilities with impact across SimCorp.

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English through our career site as soon as possible. We assess applications continuously, and only applications submitted through our system can be processed.
  
  
At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur during recruitment. To support fairness and equal opportunity for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal information such as photographs, age, or other non-professional details from your application.
  
  
If you are interested in joining SimCorp but are unsure whether this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you identify suitable opportunities.
  
  
We continuously seek to improve our talent-acquisition process and make every candidate’s experience positive and valuable. During the process, we may ask you to provide feedback, which will be highly appreciated.
  
  
**Who We Are**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become a leading provider of integrated investment-management solutions. Our colleagues represent a broad range of nationalities, educational backgrounds, professional experiences, and perspectives.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of Deutsche Börse Group. Following the merger with Axioma, we combine the strengths of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other status protected under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work.
  
  
We believe in the continuous growth and development of our employees so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

**Employment type : Full-time**
**Compensation :**
Competitive, commensurate with experience and level
  
  
***About the role***
: You will design, implement and optimize performance-critical software in C++, working close to the hardware on CPUs and GPUs. The work spans systems programming, parallel computing and GPU kernel development using CUDA and HIP.
  
  
This role suits engineers who want to understand what happens beneath the abstraction — how code maps to memory, threads and hardware — rather than only using libraries and frameworks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain high-performance C++ software for compute-intensive workloads.
* Write and optimize parallel code for multi-core CPUs and GPUs, including CUDA/HIP kernels.
* Profile applications, identify bottlenecks in compute, memory and I/O, and deliver measurable speedups.
* Optimize memory layout, access patterns and data movement across the memory hierarchy.
* Work with Linux systems internals: processes, threads, synchronization and virtual memory.
* Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code and take part in code and design reviews.
* Benchmark, debug and validate correctness and performance across hardware platforms.
* Collaborate with the team to evaluate new hardware, toolchains and optimization techniques.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field.
* 2+ years of professional experience in C/C++ development, systems programming or performance-focused engineering.
* Strong command of modern C++ (C++11 and later), including memory management, pointers, templates and OOP.
* Solid grasp of data structures, algorithms and their performance trade-offs.
* Strong understanding of operating system concepts: processes, threads, virtual memory, scheduling and synchronization.
* Hands-on experience developing and debugging on Linux (gcc/clang, gdb, make/CMake).
* Experience with multithreaded or concurrent programming (e.g., std: thread, OpenMP, threads).
* Strong analytical and debugging skills, and a habit of measuring before optimizing.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with GPU programming using CUDA or HIP/ROCm.
* Understanding of GPU architecture: warps/wavefronts, occupancy, and the memory hierarchy (global, shared, registers, caches).
* Experience with parallel programming models and HPC concepts (MPI, OpenMP, SIMD/vectorization
* Familiarity with profiling tools such as perf, VTune, Nsight Systems/Compute or rocprof.
* Knowledge of computer architecture: caches, memory bandwidth, NUMA and instruction-level parallelism.
* Exposure to compilers, LLVM, or low-level code generation. Projects or open-source contributions in C++, CUDA/HIP, compilers, systems programming or performance optimization.
* CUDA/HIP experience is a plus, not a requirement.
* Strong C++ and systems fundamentals matter most; we will help you ramp up on GPU computing.
