title: Senior Fusion Application Developer
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Developer with strong technical expertise in Oracle Fusion HCM, Oracle Recruiting, and AI/Generative AI technologies.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and deploying intelligent AI agents and enterprise applications that automate business processes, enhance employee and candidate experiences, and improve operational efficiency within the Oracle Fusion ecosystem.
  
  
This role requires strong hands-on software development capabilities, experience building AI-powered solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs) and agent orchestration frameworks, and a solid understanding of enterprise application integration and cloud technologies.
  
  
The successful candidate will be able to independently translate business requirements into secure, scalable, production-ready technical solutions, leveraging Oracle AI Agent Studio and modern AI development frameworks.
  
  
**Required Qualifications and Technical Skills:**

* 5–8 years of hands-on software development experience, including experience with enterprise applications.
* Minimum 1 year of practical experience developing AI/Generative AI solutions or LLM-powered applications.
* Hands-on development or implementation experience with Oracle Fusion HCM.
* Experience with AI agent development, agentic workflows, prompt engineering, and LLM-based application development.
* Experience deploying enterprise-grade AI applications with appropriate security, monitoring, and governance controls.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or JavaScript.
* Experience developing and consuming REST APIs, working with JSON, and implementing secure application integrations.
* Familiarity with authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth 2.0 and role-based access control.
* Knowledge of software engineering best practices, version control, testing, debugging, and CI/CD processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of complex technical deliverables, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Relevant certifications in Oracle Cloud, AI/ML, Generative AI, or cloud application development.

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and implement AI-powered applications and intelligent agents integrated with Oracle Fusion HCM and Oracle Recruiting.
* Build, configure, customize, and deploy AI agents and agentic workflows using Oracle AI Agent Studio.
* Develop custom applications, APIs, and integration components to extend Oracle Fusion HCM capabilities.
* Design and implement Generative AI solutions leveraging LLMs, prompt engineering, tool calling, and agent orchestration.
* Integrate AI agents with Oracle Fusion business objects, REST APIs, and enterprise services.
* Develop solutions that automate recruiting and HCM processes, improve user experiences, and streamline operational workflows.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product managers, architects, and development teams to translate functional requirements into technical solutions.
* Ensure AI applications adhere to enterprise security, data privacy, access control, and performance requirements.
* Perform testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of AI-powered applications and integrations.
* Contribute to technical architecture, code reviews, documentation, and software development best practices.
* Support the deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of production AI solutions.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Software Engineer- DevOps for Workflow Innovation in Barco Control Rooms @Barco**
**About Barco**
Barco designs technology to enable bright outcomes around the world. Seeing beyond the image, we develop visualization and collaboration solutions to help you work together, share insights, and wow audiences. Our focus is on three core markets: Enterprise (from meeting and control rooms to corporate spaces), Healthcare (from the radiology department to the operating room), and Entertainment (from movie theaters to live events and attractions). We have a team of 3,600 employees, located in 90 countries, whose passion for technology is captured in 400 granted patents. As part of BCR Software Development group at Barco our vision is to be a world-class software team partnering with our businesses to offer successful software solutions and outcomes that delight our customers and set the trend in our dynamic markets.
  
  
**BCR (Barco Control Rooms)**
The Barco Control Rooms business unit is making workflow and visualization solutions for the Control Room market since 1994 to help operators collect, visualize and share critical information for optimal mission-critical decision making. Today, we are still the number one choice for control room professionals who want to stay on top of their situational awareness with 12000+ installations for critical infrastructure and critical operations.
  
  
**Software Engineer - DevOps for Workflow Innovation @ Barco**
We are seeking a hands-on DevOps Engineer to join the Barco CTRL Workflow Innovation team and support the development of a new AI-driven product from the ground up. The ideal candidate must have strong experience in GCP, cloud-native DevOps, and AI/MLOps practices, with proven ability to build reliable platforms, automation, CI/CD workflows, and deployment infrastructure for data and AI product capabilities. You will work with a globally distributed team to enable scalable, secure, and production-ready delivery of intelligent workflow solutions for Barco Control Rooms.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Software Engineer - DevOps in the Workflow Innovation team, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the cloud-native engineering foundation required to develop, test, deploy, and operate AI-driven product capabilities for Barco Control Rooms. This is not a classical DevOps role focused only on build pipelines and deployments; it requires hands-on experience with AI/MLOps, cloud infrastructure, data/AI workloads, automation, observability, and secure production operations. The role will also support deployment patterns where AI capabilities may need to run closer to the operational environment, including Edge AI scenarios, hybrid cloud-edge architectures, and efficient inference workflows for mission-critical control room use cases. You will collaborate with cloud partners, product owners, architects, Data & AI engineers, developers, and validation teams across locations to enable fast, reliable, and secure delivery of workflow innovation capabilities.
  
  

* Build and maintain cloud-native DevOps and AI/MLOps infrastructure for the Workflow Innovation product on GCP.
* Design and implement CI/CD workflows for backend services, data pipelines, AI/ML components, model integration, and GenAI-enabled capabilities.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, environment management, configuration, and deployment workflows using infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Enable deployment and operation of AI/ML workloads, including model serving, inference workflows, RAG-based components, vector search services, and related data/AI services.
* Support cloud-to-edge deployment and operational patterns for AI capabilities, including lightweight model packaging, inference deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management for Edge AI scenarios.
* Establish observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, reliability, and cost-awareness practices for cloud-native Data & AI product capabilities.
* Support secure handling of product data, secrets, access control, compliance needs, and cloud security best practices.
* Work closely with Data & AI engineers and product teams to improve developer experience, release readiness, test automation, and operational reliability.
* Guide and mentor fellow colleagues in DevOps, cloud, and AI/MLOps practices while contributing to technical discussions and engineering excellence.

****Qualifications and Experience****
**Education**
We are seeking experience with the following technologies/domains:
  
  
B. Tech./B. E./M. E./M. Tech. in Computer Science/AI Engineering
  
  
**Experience**

* 3-6 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud platform engineering, SRE, AI/MLOps, or related product engineering roles.
* Strong hands-on experience with GCP is required, including relevant cloud-native compute, storage, networking, IAM, observability, and deployment services.
* Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines for cloud-native applications, backend services, data pipelines, and AI/ML workloads.
* Hands-on experience with AI/MLOps practices, including model deployment, model serving, inference workflows, experiment tracking, model versioning, and release automation for AI-enabled product features.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and environment automation using tools such as Terraform, Helm, or equivalent technologies.
* Good understanding of cloud security practices, including IAM, secrets management, network security, secure deployment patterns, and least-privilege access.
* Experience setting up monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, SLO/SLA-oriented reliability practices, and incident response workflows.
* Exposure to data and AI platforms or services such as BigQuery, Vertex AI Vector Search, Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub, vector databases, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience supporting RAG-based applications, GenAI-enabled services, model APIs, or AI inference platforms is highly desirable.
* Exposure to Edge AI concepts, hybrid cloud-edge deployments, on-device or near-device inference, model optimization, and operational constraints such as latency, reliability, connectivity, and resource usage is desirable.
* Good programming and scripting experience using Python, Bash, or similar languages, with ability to build automation and internal tooling.
* Understanding of DevSecOps practices, automated testing, quality gates, vulnerability scanning, dependency management, and secure software supply chain practices.
* Ability to collaborate with cloud partners, architects, Data & AI engineers, developers, product owners, and validation teams across geographies.
* Strong problem-solving mindset, ownership, operational discipline, and willingness to explore and adopt new technologies in AI, DevOps, and cloud engineering.

title: Sr. Software Engineer | Defence
description:
**Sr. Software Engineer | Defence and R&D(only candidates who have experience in same industry is required)**
**Location:**
Noida (Sector 132)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Experience :**
5-8 years
  
  
**About The Company-**
Zoid is a high-tech R&D startup devoted to developing cutting-edge technologies in the Defence and Aerospace sector. We primarily deliver customized solutions to the Indian Armed Forces, leveraging our expertise in AI, Electronics, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, and Robotics.
  
  
Currently Funded By The IDEX Initiative Under The Ministry Of Defence, India, We Are Working On Projects Of Strategic National Importance, Including
  
  

* AI-based FOD detection software for Naval Air Stations
* Reusable Off-board Missile Decoys for Anti-Ship Missile Defense

**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to design and lead our software architecture, AI/Computer Vision systems integration, and embedded systems infrastructure. You will be a technical leader who codes, architects, and mentors—driving both strategic system design and hands-on execution. You will take ownership of end-to-end software systems, from hardware abstraction layers through AI pipelines, ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability for defence and aerospace applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities -**
**Design & Architect Core Software Systems**

* Define system architecture for project requirements.
* Create modular, scalable design patterns that handle real-time sensor inputs and AI inference pipelines
* Design hardware abstraction layers for seamless integration with various sensors (cameras, LiDAR, thermal) and edge processors
* Establish data flow architecture, APIs, and communication protocols between components
* Document architectural decisions, design patterns, and system specifications

**Production Code Development in C++**

* Write high-performance, production-grade C++ code for critical system components
* Develop code for GPU-accelerated AI inference and image processing
* Implement multi-threaded, real-time systems with stringent latency requirements
* Conduct performance profiling and optimization (memory, CPU, GPU utilization)
* Maintain code quality through testing, code reviews, and documentation

**Hardware & Sensor Integration**

* Lead integration efforts with hardware teams: cameras, compute modules, networking equipment, sensors
* Define hardware requirements and validate hardware selections
* Implement device drivers, firmware interfaces, and hardware communication protocols
* Ensure systems remain reliable in long-term industrial/defence deployments.
* Interface with GNSS receivers, inertial measurement units (IMUs), industrial cameras, thermal/IR cameras, LIDAR, rangefinders, communication radios, gimbal systems, and other peripherals.
* Contribute to open-source drivers, configure kernel modules, and write integration layers.
* For specialized hardware (e.g., Basler/FLIR industrial cameras, Veronte autopilots, military-grade radios): work with manufacturer SDKs, understand vendor-specific APIs and protocols.
* Communicate over serial protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, RS-232, RS-422) .

**Linux Systems Software**

* Set up and optimize Linux kernel configurations for real-time performance
* Provision, configure, and harden Linux (Ubuntu) OS images for field-deployed systems: minimal attack surface, systemd service management, user/permission lockdown.
* Implement process management: watchdog timers, heartbeat monitoring, automatic service restart, graceful shutdown sequencing, zombie process management.
* Write robust Bash scripts for Ubuntu command-line automation
* Manage system-level drivers, device tree configurations, and boot processes
* Implement system monitoring, logging, and telemetry frameworks
* Handle cross-compilation, build systems (CMake, Yocto), and deployment pipelines

**Networking & Infrastructure Development**

* Design and implement network communication layers (Ethernet, CAN, MQTT, gRPC)
* Set up edge computing infrastructure and distributed system communication
* Implement secure communication protocols and data transmission standards
* Manage system interconnectivity
* Build TCP/UDP socket communication, RTSP video streaming pipelines, and mesh networking for multi-node systems.

**Technical Planning & Execution**

* Create technical roadmaps aligned with product goals (6-12 month outlook)
* Break down complex architectural work into executable sprints and milestones
* Identify technical risks, performance bottlenecks, and scalability challenges early
* Drive solutions and proof-of-concepts for new technical requirements
* Coordinate with systems engineers on end-to-end testing and validation
* Support field testing and customer deployment efforts with technical expertise

**Required Qualifications**

* 5-8 years of software development experience in complex, real-time systems
* Expert-level proficiency in C++ ; deep understanding of memory management, concurrency,multi-threading, and performance optimization
* Strong hands-on experience optimizing AI inference on GPUs
* Proven background in AI/Computer Vision (model deployment, PyTorch/TensorFlow, OpenCV)
* Deep experience with Linux kernel and linux based OS, system programming, device drivers, and embedded systems
* Solid knowledge of networking protocols, hardware integration, and sensor interfaces
* Experience with technical documentation and architectural design patterns
* Proven experience designing architectures for real-time or mission-critical systems: module decomposition, IPC, state machines, data flow, deployment topology
* Experience building multi-threaded and multi-process systems on multi-core and/or multi-GPU hardware.

title: Wordpress Developer
description:
WordPress Developer (Multi-Platform Web Developer)

**Location:**
Sector 2, Noida (On-site)

**Experience:**
3–6 years

**Company:**
Website Pandas – AI & Performance-Driven Digital Agency

About the Role

We are looking for a
**strong WordPress Developer**
who can build, customize, and maintain high-quality websites across
**WordPress, Shopify, and Webflow**
.

This is not a “plugin installer” or “page-builder-only” role.

You will work on
**production websites**
for U.S. and international clients, collaborating with SEO strategists, designers, and performance teams. The role requires technical depth, problem-solving ability, and clean execution.

If you understand how websites should be built for
**performance, scalability, and SEO**
, this role will suit you well.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and customize WordPress websites (themes, templates, custom functionality)
* Work with Shopify for storefront customization, theme edits, and basic app integrations
* Build and maintain Webflow websites with clean structure and responsive design
* Customize existing themes and, where required, develop custom components
* Handle site performance optimization, security basics, and best practices
* Implement SEO-friendly structures (clean URLs, schema readiness, CWV awareness)
* Debug issues related to plugins, themes, hosting, and third-party integrations
* Coordinate with SEO, design, and content teams for smooth execution
* Maintain staging/live workflows and follow deployment best practices

Mandatory Requirements (Please Read Carefully)

Apply only if you meet all of the following:

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in WordPress development
* Strong experience with:
* WordPress (core, themes, plugins)
* Shopify (theme customization, Liquid basics)
* Webflow (CMS, responsive builds)
* Good working knowledge of:
* PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript
* MySQL and WordPress database basics
* Experience customizing themes (not only using Elementor / WPBakery)
* Understanding of performance optimization and security fundamentals
* Strong English comprehension and communication skills
* Comfortable working full-time from our Noida Sector 2 office

We are looking for
**developers**
, not just site assemblers.

Preferred (Nice to Have)

* Experience building custom WordPress themes or plugins
* Familiarity with REST APIs or third-party integrations
* Experience with Git / version control
* Experience working with U.S. or international clients
* Awareness of Core Web Vitals and page speed optimization techniques

Why Join Website Pandas

* Work on real, production-grade websites
* Exposure to WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, and other modern stacks
* Collaborative environment with SEO and strategy teams
* Clear expectations, clean processes, and quality-driven work
* Professional on-site office environment in Noida Sector 2

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**Job Summary**
The Software Development Engineer role at Clearwater Analytics spans a spectrum of responsibilities with a focus on designing, implementing, and managing software systems. The role requires continuous learning and application of new technologies and trends. Engineers at entry-level work on coding, debugging, and learning new software technologies. With progression in this track, the responsibilities expand to include leading teams, designing complex software systems, providing mentorship, and managing cross-functional integration. The more senior roles are responsible for defining the company's technological vision, making strategic decisions, driving innovation, and setting new industry standards. Across all levels, a successful software development engineer will demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, clear communication, excellent coding abilities, a keen understanding of the software ecosystem, and a cooperative team player attitude.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, deploy, and maintain quality code that is simple, well-structured, clear, and well-tested.
* Effectively break down and solve complex problems that require research or collaboration.
* Communicate effectively, regardless of medium, audience, or timing.
* Strong command of multiple levels of automated testing (e.g., unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, etc.).
* Mentor new and less-experienced team members.
* Initiate design and feature discussions, advocating for improvements in software performance, scalability, reliability, and security.
* Coordinate with other teams to ensure the successful integration of software applications.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents quickly and effectively.
* Understand, respond to, and address customer needs and issues with empathy and timeliness.
* Any other reasonable activity required by management.

**Required Skills**

* Proficiency in a typed, object-oriented programming language.
* Deep knowledge of software methodologies, tools, and typical architectural patterns.
* Enthusiasm for software work in a software-as-a-service company.
* Driven by client satisfaction.
* Strong teamwork skills.
* Ability to manage own time and deliver expected results on time.
* Commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
* Exceptional analytical skills.
* Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Excellent attention to detail and strong documentation skills.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Exceptional problem-solving abilities.

**Education And Experience**

* Degree in Computer Science or related field.
* 4+ years of software development experience.

title: Experienced Embedded Software EngineerEngineer
description:
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an experienced embedded software engineer to lead the development, and integration of embedded platforms spanning MCU firmware, RTOS, embedded Linux, platform-management protocols, and hardware-backed security.
  
  
This role combines module-level technical ownership with hands-on development and debugging. You will implement the design of secure, resilient, and recoverable platforms while ensuring the translation of complex requirements into reusable, validated software solutions.
  
  
**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline, with 7+ years of embedded software experience and a demonstrated track record of technical ownership for complex platforms or subsystems.
* Strong hands-on proficiency in C and low-level embedded software development, with deep expertise in processor architecture, interrupts, DMA, synchronization, memory protection, and hardware–software interactions.
* Substantial expertise in one or more of the following areas: Zephyr OS, RTOS-based MCU development, or embedded Linux platform development, complemented by practical experience integrating firmware, drivers, middleware, and host-side software.
* Demonstrated implementation or architectural experience in at least one of the following domains: firmware development, secure boot, platform security, or specification-driven software development.
* Proven ability to lead complex debugging efforts, conduct architecture and code reviews, mentor engineers, and resolve technical trade-offs while remaining actively involved in implementation.
* Strong communication, technical documentation, planning, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with a proven ability to take ambiguous technical challenges from investigation through implementation and validation.
* Nice to have:

+ Experience with Rust.
+ Experience with FPGA-based firmware development.
+ Upstream open-source contributions.
+ Experience developing software for NXP MCUs or MPUs.
+ Experience with secure boot, hardware-backed security, trusted firmware, secure firmware updates, or recovery systems, including the ability to reason about trust boundaries, failure modes, and the security implications of design decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse & understand the requirement, hardware, software architecture documentation and technical direction for embedded platforms.
* Develop and implement embedded platform software solutions based on hardware and requirements documentation. Convert system requirements into robust software
* Develop & integrate firmware, drivers, subsystems (e.g., security), middleware, and applications while ensuring effective hardware-software integration. Address initialization dependencies, asynchronous communication, concurrency, resource constraints, fault handling, and recovery mechanisms.
* Support platform bring-up, and root-cause analysis across hardware, firmware, protocols, and operating system components.
* Deliver engineering quality and technical execution by establishing design review and validation standards and coordinating with cross-functional teams, architects, customers, and open-source communities.

Schengen Visa Consultancy Limited is a UK-based visa consultancy helping customers with visa appointments, documentation, and application support. We are improving our technology platform to automate operational processes, enhance our internal CRM, and build more efficient systems as the business grows.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on Software Engineer to work directly with the founder on appointment-booking automation, CRM development, backend integrations, and maintenance of our existing software platform.

The primary focus will be
**building reliable automation systems and improving our CRM**
. Website development and maintenance will be secondary responsibilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Appointment Automation**

* Develop and maintain browser automation using Playwright or Selenium.
* Automate repetitive booking and operational workflows where permitted.
* Troubleshoot failed scripts, session issues, timeouts, and website changes.
* Improve automation reliability through error handling, logging, retries, and monitoring.
* Test and maintain existing automation systems.

**2. CRM and Backend Development**

* Develop new features and maintain our existing CRM.
* Fix bugs and improve customer records, appointment tracking, and internal workflows.
* Build and integrate REST APIs with internal and third-party systems.
* Work with databases, write SQL queries, and maintain data consistency.
* Develop scheduled tasks and background jobs to automate repetitive processes.

**3. Website and System Maintenance**

* Maintain existing company websites and related backend functionality.
* Fix technical issues and implement small enhancements when required.
* Support integrations involving payments, email, messaging, and other services.
* Assist with deployments, application logs, debugging, and basic server maintenance.
* Follow good practices for testing, version control, security, and documentation.

**4. Collaboration**

* Work directly with the founder to understand requirements and priorities.
* Convert business requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Provide regular progress updates and communicate blockers early.
* Document important changes and ensure new features work reliably.

**Required Skills**

* Strong programming fundamentals in Java, JavaScript, or a comparable language.
* Practical experience with Playwright or Selenium and browser automation.
* Understanding of REST APIs, HTTP requests, JSON, and API integrations.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases such as MySQL or MariaDB.
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub, debugging, testing, and reading existing codebases.
* Ability to investigate problems independently and develop maintainable solutions.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Java, or Spring Boot.
* Familiarity with Linux servers, scheduled jobs, background workers, and deployments.
* Experience integrating payment gateways, email, telephony, or messaging services.
* Experience using AI coding tools while being able to understand and test the code produced.

Candidates do not need to know every technology listed above. Strong fundamentals and relevant practical experience are more important.

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for someone with
**approximately 2–4 years of relevant experience**
who enjoys solving technical problems, improving existing software, and building reliable automation.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role, not a CTO or engineering management position. The candidate should be comfortable working independently on assigned tasks
**while collaborating closely with the founder.**

**Working Details**

* Full-time position based in
  **Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India**
* Hybrid working arrangement.
* Direct collaboration with the founder.
* Compensation based on experience and technical assessment.
* Working hours and any support expectations will be discussed during the hiring process.

**How to Apply**

Please share your CV, current location, availability, and a brief introduction outlining your experience with automation, backend development, and API integrations. Relevant project examples or GitHub repositories are welcome.

**Email: info@schengenvisaconsultancy.co.uk**

We are looking for someone interested in growing with the business and helping us build efficient, reliable technology systems over the long term.

description:
**Business Line Description**
* NXP's MPU Engineering (ACE) team is a central engineering organization responsible for developing and delivering Systems\-on\-a\-Chip (SoCs) for NXP's Automotive, Edge, and Radar Processing business lines. MME's SoC Hardware Architecture team produces architectural solutions covering the very wide\-range of SoCs required by the business lines. The team is challenged to produce industry\-leading solutions covering very cost\-sensitive, low power devices to highly\-integrated, high performance, multi\-domain devices compliant with the latest automotive and industrial safety and security standards.


**Job Summary**
* Experience in architecting complex SoCs in leading\-edge process nodes involving multiple processors, coherent/non\-coherent interconnects, memory controllers, Ethernet interfaces, high bandwidth accelerators, high speed connectivity peripherals like PCIe etc

**Job Description:**
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Power Platform engineer to design and deliver complex enterprise solutions for clients while helping raise the technical capability of our broader Power Platform team.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on player coach role with significant client delivery responsibility. The Manager will remain deeply involved in solution architecture, software development, troubleshooting, implementation, technical reviews, and client discussions. **Key Responsibilities**

* Establish and promote engineering standards, reusable patterns, code quality expectations, and delivery best practices.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads and help improve engineering quality across the broader team.
* Help teams determine when Power Platform is the right solution and when custom development or other technologies are more appropriate.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8 or more years of professional software engineering, application development, solution architecture, or related technology experience.
* 4 or more years of substantial hands\-on Microsoft Power Platform engineering experience.
* Strong software development experience using C\#/.NET and JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Experience extending Power Platform through plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of Dataverse architecture, security, data modeling, integration patterns, solution management, and performance.
* Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating with enterprise systems.
* Experience with Azure services, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, and related technologies.
* Strong experience with ALM, source control, deployment automation, managed solutions, and CI/CD.
* Strong understanding of professional software engineering practices including code review, testing, debugging, monitoring, and production support.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery on complex enterprise application projects.
* Strong client facing communication, consulting, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, challenge assumptions, explain tradeoffs, and provide clear recommendations.
* Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical practices across a team.
* Experience working with global clients and distributed delivery teams, including appropriate overlap with US based stakeholders when required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Power Platform governance, environment strategy, security standards, or Center of Excellence practices.
* Experience with Azure technologies such as Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, or Application Insights.
* Experience working in consulting or professional services environments.
* Experience supporting presales, estimation, technical proposals, demonstrations, or workshops.
* Microsoft Power Platform or Azure certifications such as PL 400, PL 600, or related credentials.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Successful engineers in this role remain highly engaged in client delivery while also raising the technical capability of the broader team. They are trusted by clients, comfortable solving difficult engineering problems, able to make sound architecture decisions, and capable of guiding others through complex technical challenges.
   

  

 They approach Power Platform as an enterprise application development platform and combine its native capabilities with strong software engineering practices to deliver secure, scalable, maintainable solutions.
   

  

**What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe**
 Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.
   

  

 In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.
   

  

 Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.
   

  

 We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
   

  

**Our Benefits:**
 At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
   

  

**How You Can Grow:**
 We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

This individual owns the design, execution, and continuous improvement of enterprise patch management and software deployment operations across Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) and Microsoft Intune for one or more enterprise client accounts.
   

  

 At Grade 9, the engineer operates with a high degree of independence on complex patching and deployment challenges, serves as the L3 escalation point for patch and software deployment issues within the team, and actively contributes to process governance, automation, and junior team development. The role is critical to client patch compliance posture, vulnerability remediation SLA adherence, and software lifecycle discipline across large, diverse endpoint estates.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Patch Management – SCCM / MECM**
* Design and govern the end\-to\-end software update management lifecycle in SCCM — from SUP synchronisation through ADR execution, deployment targeting, and compliance reporting.
* Architect and maintain WSUS topology — upstream/downstream server configuration, product and classification scoping, synchronisation schedules, and cleanup routines.
* Build and manage Automatic Deployment Rules (ADRs) for Patch Tuesday, out\-of\-band, and zero\-day update scenarios across tiered deployment ring strategies.
* Define and enforce maintenance window frameworks across server, workstation, and critical asset device collections aligned to client change management policies.
* Manage phased patch deployment pipelines — Pilot, UAT, and Production ring progressions with dwell periods and compliance gates.
* Monitor patch compliance dashboards and produce client\-facing SLA compliance reports; drive remediation for non\-compliant devices.
* Govern Software Update Point (SUP) health — synchronisation failures, WSUS certificate management, expired update cleanup, and IIS health monitoring.
* Manage third\-party patch management integration within SCCM where applicable — SCUP, or third\-party update catalogue publishing.

title: GenAI Developer / Lead
description:

title: UI Architect
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 UI Architect (Frontend Platform \& Micro\-frontends)
   

  

**Location:** 
 India
   

  

**Experience:** 
 15\+ Years
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Engineering Manager
   

  

**About the Role \& the Team** 
 We are building a foundational Core UI Platform Team to own, scale, and govern the frontend ecosystem for our enterprise product suite.
   

  

 As the UI Architect, you will set the technical direction for our frontend platform and guide engineering teams in building scalable, secure, and maintainable user experiences. This is a hands\-on leadership role that combines architecture, platform ownership, technical governance, and active contribution to core platform capabilities.
   

  

 Your mission is to evolve a robust frontend platform through reusable components, shared libraries, developer tooling, and CI/CD practices that help product teams deliver high\-quality software faster and more consistently.
   

  

**Success in this Role** 
 Success will be measured by:
   

  

* Adoption of shared platform capabilities.
* Reuse of common components.
* Improved engineering productivity.
* Reduced technical debt.
* Consistent architecture across teams.
* Platform reliability and performance.
* Faster onboarding of frontend engineers.
* Successful framework and dependency upgrades.


**What You Will Do (Responsibilities)**
* Frontend Platform Architecture: Own the technical vision and architectural integrity of the micro\-frontend ecosystem, including routing, shared state, configuration, and integration patterns.
* Design Systems \& Shared Libraries: Lead component\-driven architecture by evolving shared UI components, design\-system packages, and non\-visual utilities that are performant, well documented, and strongly typed.
* Hands\-on Execution: Write high\-quality, production\-ready code. Tackle the most complex technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and core feature implementations alongside your Technical Lead and UI Developers.
* Tooling \& CI/CD: Own frontend build systems and GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Improve dependency management, container builds, and code\-quality gates to support fast, reliable deployments.
* Governance \& Standards: Establish and enforce standards for code quality, automated testing (Jest, Playwright), accessibility, and security. Introduce formal processes like Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) to document technical choices.
* AI\-Assisted Engineering: Define practical standards for using AI coding assistants and agentic workflows to improve frontend engineering productivity, code quality, and developer experience.
* Mentorship: Act as a force multiplier. Mentor Technical Leads and Senior UI Engineers, conduct rigorous code reviews, and elevate the overall engineering culture.


**What You Bring (Must\-Have Qualifications)**
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience, including architectural ownership of enterprise\-grade frontend platforms or large\-scale UI products.
* Expert\-level React, JavaScript \& TypeScript: Deep knowledge of React architecture, rendering optimization, modern JavaScript, and advanced TypeScript patterns.
* Frontend Architecture: Proven experience designing and delivering component\-driven, micro\-frontend, or platform\-based frontend architectures. Experience with single\-spa or similar orchestration frameworks is preferred.
* SaaS \& Multi\-Tenant Architecture: Strong understanding of designing secure enterprise SaaS applications, including authentication, authorization, Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), and multi\-tenant architectures.
* State, Data \& API Management: Strong expertise in client\-side state management, data\-fetching strategies, and type\-safe client\-server API contracts across distributed UI modules.
* Build \& DevOps Expertise: Strong understanding of modern frontend build tools (Webpack, Vite) and experience writing/managing CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD highly preferred).
* Quality Engineering: Strong understanding of frontend testing strategies, including unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing with tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or Cypress.
* Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders, Product Managers, and Backend Architects.
* Platform Engineering Experience: Experience with monorepos, internal package publishing, design systems, Storybook, and reusable developer tooling.
* Frontend Governance: Ability to define and drive standards for theming, accessibility, linting, formatting, dependency management, and architectural consistency across multiple teams.
* AI\-Assisted Development: Hands\-on familiarity with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, or similar tools, with the ability to define practical usage patterns for engineering teams.


**Good To Have (Preferred Skills)**
* Frontend Observability: Experience instrumenting client\-side RUM, error\-tracking, and distributed tracing (e.g., OpenTelemetry) to support platform reliability metrics.
* Backend for frontend / Lightweight Service Ownership: Familiarity with lightweight Node.js, Express, or equivalent services that support frontend configuration, aggregation, or API composition.
* Legacy Framework Migration: Experience modernizing applications that carry legacy CSS frameworks (e.g., Bootstrap) alongside a component\-driven design system.
* Data Visualization Architecture: Working knowledge of charting libraries (e.g., D3\.js) for teams with heavy analytics or dashboard requirements.
* Package \& Release Governance: Experience with semantic versioning, deprecation policies, private package registries, and consumer migration strategies.


 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

 NetReveal Technical Lead
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced NetReveal Technical Lead to lead the technical implementation of a high\-volume Transaction Monitoring migration.

The successful candidate will provide hands\-on leadership to the development team and work closely with Product Owner, Data, Financial Crime, Testing, Architecture and Governance stakeholders.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Lead the end\-to\-end NetReveal technical workstream including interlocks with wider migration programme.
   

  

 Assess the existing NetReveal implementation, processing model, batch schedules and technical constraints.
   

  

 Define the technical approach for loading historical customer, account and transaction data.
   

  

 Design an efficient approach for loading data at scale and reduce the existing method from 20 to 30 days to 5 or 10 days.
   

  

 Define the strategy for customer profile creation, rebuild and reprofiling.
   

  

 Ensure sufficient transaction history is available to support scenario look\-back periods.
   

  

 Evaluate alternative approaches to historical transaction and sequential batch processing.
   

  

 Lead the technical implementation of customer segmentation requirements.

 Review technical designs, code, configuration and deployment artefacts.
   

  

 Work with the Test Lead to define technically representative test scenarios.
   

  

 Agree data controls and certification approach.
   

  

 Produce technical documentation and evidence for design, risk and governance approval.
   

  

 Support cutover planning, implementation, reconciliation and post\-migration assurance.

 Extensive hands\-on experience implementing or enhancing SymphonyAI NetReveal version 8 or later (version 9 preferred).
   

  

 Strong experience with the Transaction Monitoring SMBD engine using Spark; experience limited to the classic NetReveal TM engine will not be sufficient.
   

  

 Strong understanding of NetReveal data structures, profiling, segmentation, scenarios and batch processing.
   

  

 Experience with customer profile generation, large\-scale reprofiling and migration using the TM SMBD Spark engine.

 Experience using and analysing Parquet files generated by the TM SMBD Spark engine for profile validation and migration activities.
   

  

 Strong understanding of AML Transaction Monitoring concepts.
   

  

 Experience with scenario look\-back periods, behavioural monitoring and customer segmentation.
   

  

 Strong SQL and data analysis capability.
   

  

 Experience diagnosing performance issues and optimising batch processing.
   

  

 Experience working within a highly governed banking environment.
   

  

 Ability to lead technical delivery while remaining sufficiently hands\-on.

description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Mercer Tech at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Gurugram. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
   

  

 As a
 **Lead Software Developer** 
 at Mercer, you will play a key role in shaping our future in the rapidly evolving field of, scalable Shared Services that incorporate AI capabilities. Collaboration is essential, as you will work within a team that follows Scaled Agile methodologies. We are seeking a self\-motivated and delivery\-focused individual with a strong technology background, where experience in AI integrations and prompt engineering will be advantageous, to help us grow our talent and drive innovation in this exciting sector.
   

  

**We will count on you to:**
* Ensure Shared Service requirements are gathered accurately, fully understood, and communicated clearly to all stakeholders, with transparency on impacts and dependencies.
* Design, develop, and support secure, scalable backend and frontend services using Phyton, Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
* Implement authentication and security solutions leveraging JWT, SAML/OIDC, Okta integration, Microsoft EntraID and Passport / Passport\-SAML concepts.
* Build and maintain data persistence layers using Postgresql, MongoDB and Mongoose to deliver robust and reliable application functionality.
* Develop automated tests and support quality assurance practices using Jest, NestJS testing patterns, class\-validator, and class\-transformer. Including documentation, and usage guidance to ensure shared services are easy to adopt, maintain, and support.
* Integrate applications using Express, including body\-parser and cookie\-parser, and work effectively with NestJS guards, hooks, modules, and dependency injection.
* Use Git, npm ecosystem, and environment configuration management effectively to support local development, testing, and delivery.
* Write high\-quality, maintainable code aligned to Agile user stories and established engineering standards, while leveraging AI development productivity tools such as GitHub Copilot where appropriate.
* Troubleshoot and resolve development and integration issues, with a focus on performance, authentication, and service interoperability.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, serving as a role model and supporting their growth within the team.
* Collaborate with peers to foster a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and engineering excellence.
* Champion Agile practices that support effective product delivery and strong team collaboration.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with product owners, solutions architects, analysts, and leadership to ensure alignment of technical solutions with business objectives.
* Leverage emerging technologies, including AI, to solve real\-world challenges and enhance our software solutions.
* Provide technical support to consumers of the Shared Services for existing issues and recommend enhancements to current solutions.


**What is in it for you?**
* Chance to work on enterprise\-grade shared services used by multiple teams (high visibility and impact).
* Exposure to AI integrations and prompt engineering (advantageous/valued experience).
* Work with modern engineering practices: cloud\-native architecture, CI/CD, DevOps quality gates, security\-first delivery.
* A culture of continuous improvement, learning, and knowledge sharing, with scope to grow as a technical leader.


**What you need to have:**
 We are seeking candidates with a proven track record in developing multiple products/services, ideally those that incorporate AI technologies. The ideal candidate will possess:
   

  

* Shared Services Mindset: Demonstrates a strong focus on building reusable components and services that support multiple teams, reduce duplication, and improve consistency across the platform.
* Strong Communication Skills: Ability to effectively interact with both technical and non\-technical colleagues in a cross\-functional environment.
* Strong Self\-Starter and Team Contributor: A proactive individual who takes initiative in their work, embraces a model of continuous learning to stay updated with industry trends and technologies, and actively contributes to team success by collaborating effectively and sharing knowledge with colleagues.
* Diverse Software Delivery Experience: A successful history of delivering software across a variety of languages, technologies, and platforms, with familiarity in AI frameworks and libraries being a plus.
* Agile Methodologies: Experience with Agile at Scale, Lean, and Continuous Delivery methodologies to drive efficient development processes.
* Cloud\-Native Architecture Knowledge: Familiarity with cloud\-native software architectures, particularly in deploying solutions on platforms such as AWS and Microsoft Azure, with an interest in AI applications.
* Security\-Driven Design Practices: Understanding of security\-driven design principles and experience addressing SAST/DAST findings, especially in relation to AI data handling and model security.
* CI/CD and DevOps Proficiency: Proficiency in CI/CD and DevOps practices, including the use of Quality Gates to ensure high code quality.


**Technical Skills or Qualifications Required:**
* Extensive Programming Experience: Proven experience with multiple programming languages and frameworks, with deep expertise in at least one of the following: JavaScript, TypeScript. Familiarity with AI programming languages such as Python is a plus.
* Framework Proficiency: Strong experience with frameworks such as Nest.js, Express.js, and familiarity with AI frameworks like LangFlow or LangChain.
* Prompt Engineering Skills: Solid experience with engineering prompts to effectively interact with AI models, optimizing their performance and output for various applications.
* Testing Expertise: Proficient in Unit Testing and Integration Testing, including the ability to test AI solutions and their integrations effectively.
* Container Technologies: Experience with container technologies like Docker and Kubernetes, to enhance scalability and efficiency.
* Middleware Technologies: Familiarity with any of these middleware technologies such as Kafka, Camunda, Temporal, AWS Lambda Durable function, AWS Step Function and RabbitMQ is needed.
* Design and Development Practices: Demonstrated experience in refactoring, implementing design patterns, design\-driven development, continuous integration, and application security.
* SDLC Knowledge: Solid understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) processes and practices, with experience using tools such as SharePoint, ADO, and GitHub.
* Cloud Infrastructure Experience: Experience designing and deploying applications/shared services on cloud infrastructure with providers like AWS, including S3 storage.
* Stack Knowledge: Knowledge of the MEAN stack, with an interest in leveraging this technology for AI\-driven applications.
* Senior developer with 7\-11 years of experience in software development, solution design and development, plus delivering high\-quality technical projects/services.


**Why join our team:**
* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well\-being.

title: Service Architect
description:
**Join our Team**
**About The Opportunity**
 Ericsson’s Service Architecture team, within Service Management in the Operate Service Line, is building intelligent automation and decision\-support systems for telecom\-scale managed services. In Software Development, you will design, build, test, and ship production\-grade AI services focused on Agentic AI, LLM integrations, vector retrieval, knowledge graph reasoning, and ML infrastructure. Working with platform engineers, data scientists, and product owners, you will turn AI experiments into reliable services that deliver measurable value across Ericsson’s managed service operations.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Design multi\-agent systems using LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Google ADK, or equivalent orchestration.
* Build LLM services with prompt engineering, tool/function calling, planning, memory, reflection, guardrails, fallback patterns, and RAG.
* Integrate and evaluate commercial API\-based and open\-source/self\-hosted LLMs, balancing cost, latency, accuracy, privacy, and complexity.
* Build RAG pipelines using ChromaDB, Qdrant, Vertex AI RAG, Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Milvus, or equivalent; manage embeddings, hybrid search, re\-ranking, and index lifecycle.
* Model and query property graphs and RDF/ontologies to enrich agent context, semantic reasoning, and structured retrieval.
* Create evaluation harnesses with automated scoring, human review, A/B testing, and golden datasets.
* Develop ML pipelines for feature engineering, training, evaluation, serving, fine\-tuning, packaging, versioning, and monitoring using Python, PyTorch, scikit\-learn, and HuggingFace.
* Apply ML methods including regression, classification, tree ensembles, boosting, SVMs, neural networks, clustering, PCA/UMAP, LSTMs, and Transformers.
* Monitor model drift, data quality, performance, latency, and token cost in production.
* Build clean, testable Python/PySpark services and REST/FastAPI/Flask/gRPC APIs using clean\-architecture principles.
* Contribute to CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or ArgoCD; participate in reviews, architecture discussions, documentation, runbooks, and mentoring.


**You will bring**
* 6 –15 years of software development experience and a Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or equivalent.

title: R&D Engineering, Sr Engineer
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You are someone who looks at a test failure and does not just log it, you dig until you understand why it happened and what it means for the next release. Scripting is not a chore for you, it is how you make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human brain. You have spent enough time in labs or codebases to know that quality is not something you test in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start.
   

  

 Data tells you stories. When you see a trend in regression results, you do not wait for someone else to notice, you pull the thread, ask the right questions, and surface what matters. You are comfortable working across teams, translating between what verification found, what design needs to know, and what a release checklist actually requires.
   

  

 You do not need years of experience to have a point of view. You know when a process is not working and you are not afraid to suggest a better way. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the rigor you bring to testing and automation will directly affect whether those products ship on time and work as promised.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Run kickoff and release meetings across design, verification, and release teams, making sure compliance checkpoints are hit and nothing falls through the cracks
* Execute regression testing on Embedded Memory IP, catch issues before they reach customers, and track results across release cycles
* Analyze test data to spot trends, recurring failures, and process gaps that affect product quality or schedule
* Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that eliminate manual testing steps and speed up validation workflows
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to align on quality gates, release criteria, and issue resolution timelines
* Document test results, failure analysis, and process improvements in a way that helps the next engineer understand what happened and why


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Ensure Embedded Memory IP on advanced process nodes ships with zero critical defects, directly affecting customer success and market readiness
* Reduce validation cycle time by automating repetitive test and data collection tasks, freeing engineers to focus on complex debug work
* Surface quality and process issues early in the development cycle, preventing costly delays and rework downstream
* Improve the reliability of regression infrastructure so teams can trust test results and make faster release decisions
* Strengthen compliance and traceability across the release process, reducing risk and audit friction
* Enable smarter decision\-making by turning raw test data into actionable insights for design and verification teams


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
* 2 years of experience in validation, testing, quality assurance, or a related engineering role
* Working knowledge of Python or Tcl for scripting and automation
* Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Familiarity with regression testing, release processes, or quality management systems is a plus
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to work across teams without losing track of details


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can look at a spreadsheet of test results and spot the one anomaly that matters, not just the loudest failure
* You write scripts that other people can actually read and modify six months later
* You are comfortable running a meeting with senior engineers and keeping it focused without being intimidated
* When a process does not make sense, you ask why before you follow it blindly
* You can explain a technical issue to a release manager in two sentences without losing the nuance
* You stay organized when managing multiple release tracks, test cycles, and compliance checkpoints at once


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Java
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.
   

  

 We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The TeamViewer Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platform finds and resolves IT issues before they affect users. Following the acquisition of 1E, we are bringing our core remote connectivity platform and the DEX platform together into one unified product experience. Our team builds the platform services that connect both worlds — covering authentication \& authorization federation, user synchronization, and secure service\-to\-service communication between the platforms.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong Java (Spring) and Kotlin expertise to play a key role in designing and building these platform integration services, trusted by large enterprise customers. In this role, you’ll work primarily on our core platform, owning and improving the Java\-based services that connect it to the DEX platform.
   

  

 As part of an Agile team, you’ll contribute as an individual contributor, working primarily with Java (Spring) and Kotlin. Your work will power containerized services running on Kubernetes. As the DEX platform is built on .NET, familiarity with C\# services is a welcome plus. You will be joining a young, motivated team and will play an active role in mentoring and guiding its members in best practices in software development \& Secure SDLC.
   

  

* Develop \& enhance platform services that connect our core remote connectivity platform and the DEX platform, in the areas of authentication \& authorization federation, user synchronization, and cross\-platform service\-to\-service communication
* Define the architecture, design and develop new features for our platform services in Java (Spring) and Kotlin
* Work with identity and access concepts such as token exchange, service principals, user\-context authentication, and auditing across platform boundaries
* Continuously integrate, build and deploy our solution from test system to production
* Design and implement secure, well\-documented APIs based on architecture guidelines and frameworks
* Design and build common database systems of high availability and quality
* Optimize and enhance our software with new, efficient algorithms and state\-of\-the\-art software tools and technologies
* Work independently on solutions for specified requirements and be responsible for complying with time and quality specifications
* Ensure that our software is secure, stable, scalable and runs efficiently
* Monitor the latest technical developments in your field and make proposals for improvement
* Guide and assist other team members in engineering topics relevant for the team
* Coach \& mentor junior members of a young and growing team, fostering a culture of quality, ownership and continuous learning
* Act as an advisor for product owners (feasibility studies and time estimates for new functionality to be implemented)
* Collaborate closely with the teams owning the DEX platform to align on interfaces, contracts and integration flows


**Requirements**
* A university degree in the field of information technology, computer science and engineering or a related subject
* 7\+ years of professional experience in the field of software development
* Solid knowledge of Java (Spring), Kotlin and SQL is mandatory
* Solid understanding of authentication \& authorization concepts (e.g. OAuth2/OIDC, token exchange, service\-to\-service and user\-context authentication)
* Hands on experience with cloud services (like managed Kubernetes, Redis, key vaults, message brokers, PostgreSQL etc), docker containers and CI/CD pipelines
* Must have hands on experience in Docker \& Kubernetes ecosystem and should be able to work on them locally in docker desktop.
* Must have experience in any of the unit test casing framework
* Experience in taking architectural decisions about the development and maintenance of large\-scale distributed systems and integrations between platforms and services
* Solid knowledge of Secure SDLC principles, OWASP Top\-10 vulnerabilities \& remediation, and Threat Modeling
* Experience in quick feasibility studies, POC \& prototyping to arrive at firm estimates
* Understanding of Clean Code and Design Patterns for object\-orientated programming
* Proven ability and willingness to mentor and coach junior engineers, paired with strong communication skills
* A positive and solution\-oriented mindset paired with a structured and analytical way of thinking/working, being a team player, as well as motivated to learn new things
* Knowledge of .NET (C\#) backend services is a plus (the DEX platform is built on .NET)
* Experience in any of the following is desirable: parallel programming (multi\-threading), test automation, network communications, digital certificates/PKI
* Familiarity with AI tools for coding (like Co\-pilot) is a plus


 TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C\-A\-R\-E and understand that our diverse, values\-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: Associate Software Engineer
description:
**Associate Software Engineer (Backend) — Digital Platform \& Engineering** 




**Location:** 
 Noida (work from office, 5 days a week)
 



**Experience:** 
 1–2 years
 



**Team:** 
 Digital Platform \& Engineering (DPE)
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Engineering Manager, DPE
 



  





**Who we are** 




 Over the past 17 years, Medanta has created an unrivalled impact in delivering world\-class multi\-specialty care for patients in India. We have hospitals in Gurgaon, Noida, Lucknow, Patna, Indore and Ranchi. In addition, we have clinics in Defence Colony (South Delhi), Cyber City \& Subhash Chowk (Gurgaon), and at the Delhi Airport. Medanta continues to expand its healthcare ecosystem through diagnostics, pharmacies, homecare services and digital health initiatives.
 



 Digital Platform \& Engineering (DPE) is Medanta's newly built product and technology organization. Modelled on India's leading internet companies, DPE brings together product managers, designers and engineers to build the products and platforms that power patient journeys, clinical care and hospital operations across the Medanta network. We work from our own office in Noida, with strong sponsorship from the CEO and the stability of a profitable, publicly listed healthcare group.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for Associate Software Engineers with strong computer science fundamentals and early hands\-on experience of how real software gets built, reviewed and shipped. You will build backend services and APIs that doctors, nurses and patients rely on every day.
 



 This is a role for engineers who want to learn fast in a small, high\-calibre team. You will work alongside experienced engineering managers and senior engineers, with engineering levels and practices modelled on India's top product companies. We move with startup energy, but in healthcare quality is non\-negotiable, so you will learn to build software that is fast to ship and safe to trust.
 



  





**What You Will Work On** 



* **Seamless patient journeys** 
 — the services behind finding the right doctor, booking a visit, diagnostics, payments, discharge and follow\-up across OPD, IPD, emergency and day care.
* **Products that empower clinicians and caregivers** 
 — technology that assists doctors, nurses and care teams managing heavy patient loads.
* **Platform\-first foundations** 
 — reusable services such as payments, care subscriptions, scheduling and a unified patient record, designed once and used by every product across the network.
* **Voice\-first, touch\-first and AI\-first experiences** 
 — backends for products where people speak instead of type, tap instead of filling forms, and are assisted by AI at every step.
* **A Hospital Information System built from scratch** 
 — the core clinical platform, including EMR, that runs every hospital workflow.
* **Intelligence and interoperability** 
 — AI\-powered services, healthcare data platforms, and integrations with national digital health standards such as ABDM and FHIR.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, build, test and ship backend services and APIs in Java (Spring Boot) or Python (FastAPI), with guidance from senior engineers.
* Write clean, well\-tested and maintainable code; take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.
* Understand the components of the systems you work on — databases, caches such as Redis, message queues such as Kafka — and why each is used.
* Model data and write efficient queries on relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Debug and fix issues across development and production, and contribute to monitoring and reliability.
* Work closely with product managers, designers and senior engineers to understand requirements and the clinical workflows behind them, including occasional visits to our hospitals.
* Ask questions, think independently, and constructively challenge designs when something does not add up.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents throughout development — planning, implementing, testing and refactoring — while owning every line you ship, whether you or an AI wrote it.
* Follow secure coding and data\-privacy practices for systems that handle patient data — audit trails, role\-based access control and encryption of sensitive data, in line with regulations such as the DPDP Act — and strict guardrails so patient information is never exposed to unapproved AI tools.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




***Must have***



* 1–2 years of software development experience at a product company, startup or technology services company, with exposure to a real development workflow — version control, code reviews, testing and deployments.
* Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures and algorithms, object\-oriented programming, databases, and operating systems and networking basics.
* Proficiency in Java or Python.
* Hands\-on use of AI coding assistants and agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) in day\-to\-day development — writing effective prompts, breaking tasks down for an agent, and rigorously reviewing and testing what it produces.
* A clear understanding of the project you currently work on — its design, the components used, and the reasons behind those choices.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, and the ability to explain your thinking clearly while solving a problem.
* Good written and verbal communication.
* A builder's mindset: excited to build from the ground up, comfortable with ambiguity, and keen to take ownership.
* A product mindset — curiosity about how hospitals work, and care for the outcome for the user, not just the ticket.
* Depth over frequent switches — we value engineers who have stayed long enough in a role to learn from it.



***Good to have***



* Hands\-on experience with Spring Boot or FastAPI.
* Exposure to Redis, Kafka, or other caching and messaging systems.
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms such as AWS.
* Internships, open\-source contributions, or side projects that have been used by real users.
* Personal or internship projects that use LLM APIs or build simple agents.
* Competitive programming experience.
* Exposure to frontend development (React).



  





**Education** 



* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT or a related field from a top\-tier institution (IITs, IIITs, NITs, BITS or equivalent).



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Build from the ground up — a Hospital Information System, shared platforms, and voice\-first and AI\-first products — at the scale of one of India's leading hospital networks.
* Learn in a small, flat, high\-calibre team, with close access to engineering leadership and the Chief Digital Officer.
* An engineering bar and career ladder modelled on India's top product companies, with a clear path for growth.
* See your code used by doctors, nurses and patients — and work alongside some of India's most respected clinicians.
* Access to the latest AI coding tools, and a team that is rethinking how software gets built.
* A tech\-first culture: our own office, a flat and informal environment, and open\-door leadership.
* The energy of a startup with the stability of a profitable, publicly listed healthcare group.
